<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Autounattend Windows 10/11 Customization and Optimization Script
.DESCRIPTION
    Applies registry settings, UWP app removals, optimizations and customizations based on Windows version detection
.NOTES
    Requires Administrator privileges
    Compatible with Windows 10 and Windows 11
    Logs all activities to C:\ProgramData\Autounattend\Unattend\Logs\CustomizationLog.txt
.PARAMETER UserCustomizations
    When specified, applies ONLY HKCU (user-specific) registry settings.
    When not specified, applies all settings EXCEPT HKCU entries.
    Note: User customizations are tracked and will only apply once per user.
    To re-apply, delete: HKCU\Software\Autounattend\UserCustomizationsApplied
.EXAMPLE
    .\SystemCustomizations.ps1
    Runs in normal mode - applies all system-wide settings (HKLM) but skips user settings (HKCU)
.EXAMPLE
    .\SystemCustomizations.ps1 -UserCustomizations
    Runs in user mode - applies ONLY user-specific settings (HKCU)
#>

# Invoked twice: as SYSTEM without the switch (HKLM-wide work) and as the interactive
# user with -UserCustomizations (HKCU work). The one-shot task below bridges both contexts.
param(
    [switch]$UserCustomizations,
    [string]$ExpectedSid
)

# ============================================================================
# LOGGING SETUP
# ============================================================================

$LogPath = 'C:\ProgramData\Autounattend\Unattend\Logs\CustomizationLog.txt'
$null = New-Item -Path (Split-Path $LogPath) -ItemType Directory -Force

function Write-Log {
    param(
        [string]$Message,
        [ValidateSet("INFO", "SUCCESS", "WARNING", "ERROR")]
        [string]$Level = "INFO"
    )

    $Timestamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
    $LogEntry = "[$Timestamp] [$Level] $Message"

    # Write to log file
    Add-Content -Path $LogPath -Value $LogEntry -Encoding UTF8

    # Optional: Also write to console for real-time monitoring
    # Uncomment the next line if you want console output during testing
    # Write-Host $LogEntry
}

# Initialize log file
Write-Log "=================================================================================" "INFO"
Write-Log "Autounattend Windows Optimization & Customization Script Started" "INFO"
Write-Log "Script Path: $($MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path)" "INFO"
Write-Log "Log File: $LogPath" "INFO"
if ($UserCustomizations) {
    Write-Log "MODE: User Customizations Only (HKCU registry entries)" "INFO"
} else {
    Write-Log "MODE: System Customizations (All settings except HKCU entries)" "INFO"
}
Write-Log "=================================================================================" "INFO"

$script:CustomizationHadErrors = $false
$script:CustomizationDeferred = $false
$script:PermanentErrorCount = 0
$script:TrackAppliedOperations = $false
$script:AppliedOperationKeys = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]'
$script:BloatStatus = 'PENDING'
$script:OneDriveStatus = 'PENDING'
$script:UserPhaseStatus = 'PENDING'
$script:CleanupStatus = 'PENDING'

# Interactive identity resolution. The profile folder name is NOT an identity:
# the SID comes from the Explorer owner and ProfileList is consulted BY SID.
# Ambiguous sessions or identities fail closed; there is no fallback to the
# first account, the first profile or a path-derived SID.
function Resolve-TMPCInteractiveIdentity {
    param(
        [object[]]$ExplorerProcesses,
        [object[]]$Profiles,
        [string]$CurrentSid
    )

    $explorers = @($ExplorerProcesses | Where-Object { $_ -and ([int]$_.SessionId -gt 0) })
    if ($explorers.Count -eq 0) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='NO_EXPLORER'; Sid=$null; UserName=$null; SessionId=0; ProfilePath=$null; Detail='No Explorer process in an interactive session.' }
    }

    $sessionIds = @($explorers | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.SessionId } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if ($sessionIds.Count -ne 1) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='AMBIGUOUS_SESSION'; Sid=$null; UserName=$null; SessionId=0; ProfilePath=$null; Detail='More than one interactive session has Explorer.' }
    }

    $ownerSids = @($explorers | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.OwnerSid } | Where-Object { $_ })
    if ($ownerSids.Count -ne $explorers.Count) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='OWNER_UNKNOWN'; Sid=$null; UserName=$null; SessionId=$sessionIds[0]; ProfilePath=$null; Detail='An Explorer owner SID could not be read.' }
    }

    $uniqueSids = @($ownerSids | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if ($uniqueSids.Count -ne 1) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='AMBIGUOUS_IDENTITY'; Sid=$null; UserName=$null; SessionId=$sessionIds[0]; ProfilePath=$null; Detail='Explorer processes in the same session have different SIDs.' }
    }

    $sid = [string]$uniqueSids[0]
    if ($CurrentSid -and -not [string]::Equals($CurrentSid, $sid, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='IDENTITY_MISMATCH'; Sid=$sid; UserName=$null; SessionId=$sessionIds[0]; ProfilePath=$null; Detail='The current process identity does not match the interactive identity.' }
    }

    $profile = @($Profiles | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]::Equals([string]$_.Sid, $sid, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Select-Object -First 1)
    if ($profile.Count -eq 0) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='PROFILE_NOT_FOUND'; Sid=$sid; UserName=$null; SessionId=$sessionIds[0]; ProfilePath=$null; Detail='The interactive SID has no ProfileList entry.' }
    }

    $userName = @($explorers | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.OwnerUser } | Where-Object { $_ } | Select-Object -First 1)
    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Status      = 'OK'
        Sid         = $sid
        UserName    = [string]$userName
        SessionId   = [int]$sessionIds[0]
        ProfilePath = [string]$profile[0].ProfileImagePath
        Detail      = 'Interactive identity verified by Explorer owner SID and ProfileList.'
    }
}

function Test-TMPCIdentityMatch {
    param(
        [string]$ExpectedSid,
        [string]$ActualSid,
        [string]$LinkedSid
    )
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ExpectedSid) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ActualSid)) { return $false }
    if (-not [string]::Equals($ExpectedSid, $ActualSid, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return $false }
    if ($LinkedSid -and -not [string]::Equals($ExpectedSid, $LinkedSid, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return $false }
    return $true
}

function Get-TMPCInteractiveIdentity {
    $explorers = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    try {
        foreach ($process in @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'explorer.exe'" -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $ownerSid = $null
            $ownerUser = $null
            try {
                $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $process -MethodName GetOwnerSid -ErrorAction Stop
                if ($owner.ReturnValue -eq 0 -and $owner.Sid) { $ownerSid = [string]$owner.Sid }
            } catch { }
            try {
                $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $process -MethodName GetOwner -ErrorAction Stop
                if ($owner.ReturnValue -eq 0 -and $owner.User) { $ownerUser = [string]$owner.User }
            } catch { }
            $null = $explorers.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                SessionId = [int]$process.SessionId
                OwnerSid  = $ownerSid
                OwnerUser = $ownerUser
            })
        }
    } catch { }

    $profiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    try {
        foreach ($key in @(Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList' -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $profilePath = $null
            try { $profilePath = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $key.PSPath -Name 'ProfileImagePath' -ErrorAction Stop).ProfileImagePath } catch { }
            if ($profilePath) {
                $null = $profiles.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Sid = [string]$key.PSChildName; ProfileImagePath = [string]$profilePath })
            }
        }
    } catch { }

    return (Resolve-TMPCInteractiveIdentity -ExplorerProcesses @($explorers) -Profiles @($profiles))
}

# Trusted diagnostic ACL and summary integrity helpers. These functions are
# pure decision code except for the read-only ACL snapshot probe. The cleanup
# command embeds the same definitions so the task does not trust the summary
# merely because it is under ProgramData.
function Get-TMPCPrivilegedSidList {
    return @(
        'S-1-5-18',
        'S-1-5-32-544',
        'S-1-3-0',
        'S-1-5-80-956008885-3418522649-1831038044-1853292631-2271478464'
    )
}

function Test-TMPCPrivilegedSid {
    param([string]$Sid)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Sid)) { return $false }
    if ($Sid -in (Get-TMPCPrivilegedSidList)) { return $true }
    if ($Sid -match '^S-1-5-21-\d+-\d+-\d+-(512|519)$') { return $true }
    return $false
}

function Get-TMPCAclSnapshot {
    param([string]$Path)
    $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    $acl = Get-Acl -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction Stop
    $ownerSid = [string]$acl.Owner
    try {
        $ownerSid = ([System.Security.Principal.NTAccount]::new([string]$acl.Owner)).Translate([System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value
    } catch { }
    $rules = @()
    foreach ($rule in @($acl.Access)) {
        $identity = [string]$rule.IdentityReference
        try {
            $identity = $rule.IdentityReference.Translate([System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value
        } catch { }
        $rules += [pscustomobject]@{
            Identity    = [string]$identity
            Rights      = [string]$rule.FileSystemRights
            RightsValue = [int]$rule.FileSystemRights
            Type        = [string]$rule.AccessControlType
        }
    }
    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Path        = [string]$item.FullName
        Exists      = $true
        IsContainer = [bool]$item.PSIsContainer
        Attributes  = $item.Attributes
        OwnerSid    = [string]$ownerSid
        Rules       = @($rules)
    }
}

function Test-TMPCDirectoryAclSnapshot {
    param($Snapshot)
    if ($null -eq $Snapshot -or -not $Snapshot.Exists -or -not $Snapshot.IsContainer) { return $false }
    if (($Snapshot.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { return $false }
    if (-not (Test-TMPCPrivilegedSid -Sid ([string]$Snapshot.OwnerSid))) { return $false }
    # Effective rights are evaluated with specific numeric FileSystemRights bits.
    # Composite names such as Modify or FullControl also contain read/synchronize
    # bits and cannot be used directly as a safe mask.
    $unsafe = [int]([System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::Delete -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::DeleteSubdirectoriesAndFiles -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::ChangePermissions -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::TakeOwnership -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::WriteData -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::AppendData -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::WriteAttributes -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::WriteExtendedAttributes)
    foreach ($rule in @($Snapshot.Rules)) {
        if ([string]$rule.Type -ne 'Allow') { continue }
        if (Test-TMPCPrivilegedSid -Sid ([string]$rule.Identity)) { continue }
        if (@($rule.PSObject.Properties.Name) -notcontains 'RightsValue') { return $false }
        if (([int]$rule.RightsValue -band $unsafe) -ne 0) { return $false }
    }
    return $true
}

function Test-TMPCFileAclSnapshot {
    param($Snapshot)
    if ($null -eq $Snapshot -or -not $Snapshot.Exists -or $Snapshot.IsContainer) { return $false }
    if (($Snapshot.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { return $false }
    if (-not (Test-TMPCPrivilegedSid -Sid ([string]$Snapshot.OwnerSid))) { return $false }
    # Write, append, delete or control changes on a summary file owned by a
    # non-privileged identity would allow substitution; use specific bits rather
    # than composite names that include read/synchronize rights.
    $unsafe = [int]([System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::WriteData -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::AppendData -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::WriteAttributes -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::WriteExtendedAttributes -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::Delete -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::ChangePermissions -bor
        [System.Security.AccessControl.FileSystemRights]::TakeOwnership)
    foreach ($rule in @($Snapshot.Rules)) {
        if ([string]$rule.Type -ne 'Allow') { continue }
        if (Test-TMPCPrivilegedSid -Sid ([string]$rule.Identity)) { continue }
        if (@($rule.PSObject.Properties.Name) -notcontains 'RightsValue') { return $false }
        if (([int]$rule.RightsValue -band $unsafe) -ne 0) { return $false }
    }
    return $true
}

function Test-TMPCDiagnosticAclSnapshot {
    param($DirectorySnapshot, $FileSnapshot)
    return ((Test-TMPCDirectoryAclSnapshot -Snapshot $DirectorySnapshot) -and
        (Test-TMPCFileAclSnapshot -Snapshot $FileSnapshot))
}

function Test-TMPCPropertyPresent {
    param($Object, [string[]]$Names)
    if ($null -eq $Object) { return $false }
    $present = @($Object.PSObject.Properties.Name)
    foreach ($name in $Names) {
        if ($present -notcontains $name) { return $false }
    }
    return $true
}

function Test-TMPCSetupSummarySchema {
    param($Summary, [string]$ExpectedRevision = 'R2-local')
    $required = @(
        'SchemaVersion','Profile','Revision','ExecutionId','SystemPhase','SystemHadErrors',
        'SystemDeferred','BloatStatus','OneDriveStatus','UserTaskRegistration','HkcUserPhase',
        'HkcHadErrors','HkcDeferred','HkcAttempts','HkcOutcome','HkcRetryExhausted','HkcReason',
        'CleanupStatus','CleanupAttempts','CleanupReason',
        'CleanupTimestampUtc','OverallStatus','TimestampUtc'
    )
    if (-not (Test-TMPCPropertyPresent -Object $Summary -Names $required)) { return $false }
    if ([int]$Summary.SchemaVersion -ne 1) { return $false }
    if ([string]$Summary.Profile -ne 'TMPC-Windows-11-Optimization') { return $false }
    if ([string]$Summary.Revision -ne $ExpectedRevision) { return $false }

    $executionGuid = [Guid]::Empty
    if (-not [Guid]::TryParse([string]$Summary.ExecutionId, [ref]$executionGuid) -or $executionGuid -eq [Guid]::Empty) { return $false }

    $validPhases = @('SUCCESS','PARTIAL_SUCCESS','FAILED','DEFERRED','UNKNOWN_OR_INTERRUPTED')
    $system = [string]$Summary.SystemPhase
    $hkc = [string]$Summary.HkcUserPhase
    $overall = [string]$Summary.OverallStatus
    if ($system -notin $validPhases -or $hkc -notin $validPhases -or $overall -notin $validPhases) { return $false }
    if ([string]$Summary.OverallStatus -ne (Get-TMPCOverallStatus -SystemPhase $system -HkcUserPhase $hkc)) { return $false }

    $hkcAttempts = -1
    if (-not [int]::TryParse([string]$Summary.HkcAttempts, [ref]$hkcAttempts) -or $hkcAttempts -lt 0 -or $hkcAttempts -gt 3) { return $false }
    $hkcOutcome = [string]$Summary.HkcOutcome
    if ($hkcOutcome -notin @('PENDING','SUCCESS','TRANSIENT','PERMANENT','DEFERRED','NOT_APPLICABLE','UNKNOWN')) { return $false }
    if ($Summary.HkcRetryExhausted -isnot [bool]) { return $false }
    $hkcReason = [string]$Summary.HkcReason
    if ($hkcReason -and $hkcReason -notmatch '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$') { return $false }
    if ($hkc -eq 'SUCCESS') {
        if ($hkcOutcome -ne 'SUCCESS' -or $hkcAttempts -lt 1 -or [bool]$Summary.HkcRetryExhausted) { return $false }
    }
    if ($hkc -eq 'PENDING' -and $hkcAttempts -ne 0) { return $false }
    if ($hkc -eq 'FAILED' -and $hkcOutcome -notin @('TRANSIENT','PERMANENT','NOT_APPLICABLE','UNKNOWN')) { return $false }
    if ($hkc -eq 'DEFERRED' -and $hkcOutcome -ne 'DEFERRED') { return $false }
    if ([bool]$Summary.HkcRetryExhausted -and $hkc -ne 'FAILED') { return $false }

    $cleanupStatuses = @('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS','SUCCESS','FAILED','DEFERRED')
    if ([string]$Summary.CleanupStatus -notin $cleanupStatuses) { return $false }
    $attempts = 0
    if (-not [int]::TryParse([string]$Summary.CleanupAttempts, [ref]$attempts) -or $attempts -lt 0) { return $false }
    $timestamp = [DateTime]::MinValue
    if (-not [DateTime]::TryParse([string]$Summary.TimestampUtc, [ref]$timestamp)) { return $false }

    if ($system -eq 'SUCCESS') {
        if ([bool]$Summary.SystemHadErrors -or [bool]$Summary.SystemDeferred) { return $false }
        if ([string]$Summary.BloatStatus -ne 'SUCCESS' -or [string]$Summary.OneDriveStatus -ne 'SUCCESS' -or [string]$Summary.UserTaskRegistration -ne 'SUCCESS') { return $false }
    }
    if ($hkc -eq 'SUCCESS') {
        if ([bool]$Summary.HkcHadErrors -or [bool]$Summary.HkcDeferred) { return $false }
    }
    if ($hkc -eq 'FAILED' -and -not [bool]$Summary.HkcHadErrors) { return $false }
    if ($hkc -eq 'DEFERRED' -and -not [bool]$Summary.HkcDeferred) { return $false }
    return $true
}

function Test-TMPCSetupExecutionIdentity {
    param($Summary, [string]$RegistryExecutionId)
    if ($null -eq $Summary -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RegistryExecutionId)) { return $false }
    $summaryId = [string]$Summary.ExecutionId
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($summaryId)) { return $false }
    return [string]::Equals($summaryId, $RegistryExecutionId, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Resolve-TMPCCleanupTaskState {
    param([bool]$QuerySucceeded, [bool]$TaskFound, [bool]$ErrorIsNotFound)
    if (-not $QuerySucceeded) {
        if ($ErrorIsNotFound) { return 'ABSENT_VERIFIED' }
        return 'UNKNOWN'
    }
    if ($TaskFound) { return 'PRESENT' }
    return 'UNKNOWN'
}

function Get-TMPCCleanupTaskState {
    try {
        $task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AutounattendUserCustomizations' -TaskPath '\Autounattend\' -ErrorAction Stop
        $found = ($null -ne $task)
        return (Resolve-TMPCCleanupTaskState -QuerySucceeded $true -TaskFound $found -ErrorIsNotFound $false)
    } catch {
        $notFound = ($_.CategoryInfo.Category -eq 'ObjectNotFound') -or
            ($_.FullyQualifiedErrorId -match 'NotFound') -or
            ($_.Exception.Message -match 'No MSFT_ScheduledTask')
        return (Resolve-TMPCCleanupTaskState -QuerySucceeded $false -TaskFound $false -ErrorIsNotFound $notFound)
    }
}

function Get-TMPCCleanupDecision {
    param(
        $Summary,
        [string]$RegistryExecutionId,
        $DirectoryAcl,
        $FileAcl,
        [string]$TaskState,
        [string]$ExpectedRevision = 'R2-local'
    )
    if (-not (Test-TMPCDiagnosticAclSnapshot -DirectorySnapshot $DirectoryAcl -FileSnapshot $FileAcl)) { return 'STOP' }
    if (-not (Test-TMPCSetupSummarySchema -Summary $Summary -ExpectedRevision $ExpectedRevision)) { return 'STOP' }
    if (-not (Test-TMPCSetupExecutionIdentity -Summary $Summary -RegistryExecutionId $RegistryExecutionId)) { return 'STOP' }
    if ($TaskState -eq 'PRESENT' -or $TaskState -eq 'UNKNOWN') { return 'RETRY' }
    if ($TaskState -ne 'ABSENT_VERIFIED') { return 'STOP' }
    if ([string]$Summary.OverallStatus -ne 'SUCCESS') { return 'STOP' }
    return 'ALLOW'
}

# Diagnostic summary. The only accepted location is the fixed ProgramData
# diagnostics directory. Reparse points, redirected paths and untrusted ACLs
# fail closed.
function Get-TMPCDiagnosticDirectory {
    $programData = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:ProgramData).TrimEnd('\')
    $expected = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $programData 'TMPC-Windows-11-Optimization\Logs'))
    $allowedPrefix = $programData + '\TMPC-Windows-11-Optimization\Logs'
    if (-not $expected.StartsWith($allowedPrefix, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        throw 'Unsafe diagnostic path.'
    }

    $probe = $expected
    while ($probe -and -not [string]::Equals($probe, $programData, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $probe) {
            $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $probe -Force -ErrorAction Stop
            if (($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) {
                throw 'Diagnostic path is redirected.'
            }
        }
        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $probe
        if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $probe) { break }
        $probe = $parent
    }

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $expected)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $expected -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    }
    $directory = Get-Item -LiteralPath $expected -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    if (-not $directory.PSIsContainer -or (($directory.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0)) {
        throw 'Diagnostic directory is not safe.'
    }
    $directoryAcl = Get-TMPCAclSnapshot -Path $directory.FullName
    if (-not (Test-TMPCDirectoryAclSnapshot -Snapshot $directoryAcl)) {
        throw 'Diagnostic directory ACL is not trusted.'
    }
    $parentPath = Split-Path -Parent $directory.FullName
    $parentAcl = Get-TMPCAclSnapshot -Path $parentPath
    if (-not (Test-TMPCDirectoryAclSnapshot -Snapshot $parentAcl)) {
        throw 'Diagnostic parent ACL is not trusted.'
    }
    return $directory.FullName
}

function Get-TMPCSetupSummaryPath {
    $directory = Get-TMPCDiagnosticDirectory
    return (Join-Path $directory 'SetupSummary.json')
}

function Read-TMPCSetupSummary {
    $path = Get-TMPCSetupSummaryPath
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
    try {
        return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json)
    } catch {
        return $null
    }
}

function Write-TMPCSetupSummary {
    param(
        [hashtable]$Values = @{},
        [switch]$Reset
    )

    $directory = Get-TMPCDiagnosticDirectory
    $path = Join-Path $directory 'SetupSummary.json'
    $data = [ordered]@{}

    if (-not $Reset) {
        $existing = Read-TMPCSetupSummary
        if ($null -eq $existing) { throw 'Existing setup summary is missing or invalid.' }
        foreach ($property in $existing.PSObject.Properties) { $data[$property.Name] = $property.Value }
    }
    foreach ($key in @($Values.Keys)) { $data[$key] = $Values[$key] }
    $data['TimestampUtc'] = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')

    $json = $data | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
    $temp = Join-Path $directory ('SetupSummary.' + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + '.tmp')
    try {
        [IO.File]::WriteAllText($temp, $json, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
        Move-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Destination $path -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        throw
    }
    try {
        $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        if ($item.PSIsContainer -or $item.Length -le 0) { throw 'Setup summary file verification failed.' }
        $fileAcl = Get-TMPCAclSnapshot -Path $path
        if (-not (Test-TMPCFileAclSnapshot -Snapshot $fileAcl)) { throw 'Setup summary file ACL is not trusted.' }
        $persisted = Read-TMPCSetupSummary
        if ($null -eq $persisted) { throw 'Setup summary read-back failed.' }
        foreach ($key in @($data.Keys)) {
            $property = $persisted.PSObject.Properties[$key]
            if ($null -eq $property -or [string]$property.Value -ne [string]$data[$key]) {
                throw 'Setup summary read-back content mismatch.'
            }
        }
        return $path
    } catch {
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        throw
    }
}

function Get-TMPCOverallStatus {
    param([string]$SystemPhase, [string]$HkcUserPhase)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SystemPhase) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($HkcUserPhase)) { return 'UNKNOWN_OR_INTERRUPTED' }
    if ($SystemPhase -eq 'PENDING' -or $HkcUserPhase -eq 'PENDING') { return 'UNKNOWN_OR_INTERRUPTED' }
    if ($SystemPhase -eq 'UNKNOWN_OR_INTERRUPTED' -or $HkcUserPhase -eq 'UNKNOWN_OR_INTERRUPTED') { return 'UNKNOWN_OR_INTERRUPTED' }
    if ($SystemPhase -eq 'SUCCESS' -and $HkcUserPhase -eq 'SUCCESS') { return 'SUCCESS' }
    if ($SystemPhase -eq 'FAILED' -and $HkcUserPhase -eq 'FAILED') { return 'FAILED' }
    if ($SystemPhase -eq 'FAILED' -or $HkcUserPhase -eq 'FAILED') { return 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' }
    if ($SystemPhase -eq 'DEFERRED' -or $HkcUserPhase -eq 'DEFERRED') { return 'DEFERRED' }
    return 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS'
}

function Update-TMPCUserPhaseSummary {
    param(
        [string]$Phase,
        [bool]$HadErrors,
        [bool]$Deferred,
        [int]$Attempts = -1,
        [string]$Outcome,
        [bool]$RetryExhausted = $false,
        [string]$Reason = ''
    )
    $existing = Read-TMPCSetupSummary
    if ($null -eq $existing) { throw 'Setup summary is missing or invalid.' }
    if ([int]$existing.SchemaVersion -ne 1 -or
        [string]$existing.Profile -ne 'TMPC-Windows-11-Optimization' -or
        [string]$existing.Revision -ne 'R2-local') {
        throw 'Setup summary schema or revision is incompatible.'
    }
    $registryExecutionId = Get-TMPCSetupExecutionId
    if (-not (Test-TMPCSetupExecutionIdentity -Summary $existing -RegistryExecutionId $registryExecutionId)) {
        throw 'Setup summary does not belong to this execution.'
    }
    if ($Attempts -lt 0) {
        $existingAttempts = 0
        if (@($existing.PSObject.Properties.Name) -contains 'HkcAttempts') { $existingAttempts = [int]$existing.HkcAttempts }
        $Attempts = $existingAttempts
    }
    if ($Phase -eq 'SUCCESS' -and $Attempts -lt 1) { $Attempts = 1 }
    if ($Phase -eq 'PENDING') { $Attempts = 0 }
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Outcome)) {
        $Outcome = switch ($Phase) {
            'SUCCESS' { 'SUCCESS' }
            'DEFERRED' { 'DEFERRED' }
            'FAILED' { 'TRANSIENT' }
            default { 'PENDING' }
        }
    }
    $overall = Get-TMPCOverallStatus -SystemPhase ([string]$existing.SystemPhase) -HkcUserPhase $Phase
    $path = Write-TMPCSetupSummary -Values @{
        HkcUserPhase = $Phase
        HkcHadErrors = $HadErrors
        HkcDeferred = $Deferred
        HkcAttempts = $Attempts
        HkcOutcome = $Outcome
        HkcRetryExhausted = $RetryExhausted
        HkcReason = $Reason
        CleanupStatus = 'PENDING'
        CleanupReason = ''
        CleanupTimestampUtc = ''
        OverallStatus = $overall
    }
    $persisted = Read-TMPCSetupSummary
    if (-not (Test-TMPCSetupSummarySchema -Summary $persisted -ExpectedRevision 'R2-local')) {
        throw 'Setup summary schema verification failed after the user phase update.'
    }
    return $path
}

function Get-TMPCCleanupCommand {
    $functionNames = @(
        'Get-TMPCPrivilegedSidList',
        'Test-TMPCPrivilegedSid',
        'Get-TMPCAclSnapshot',
        'Test-TMPCDirectoryAclSnapshot',
        'Test-TMPCFileAclSnapshot',
        'Test-TMPCDiagnosticAclSnapshot',
        'Test-TMPCPropertyPresent',
        'Get-TMPCOverallStatus',
        'Test-TMPCSetupSummarySchema',
        'Test-TMPCSetupExecutionIdentity',
        'Resolve-TMPCCleanupTaskState',
        'Get-TMPCCleanupTaskState',
        'Get-TMPCCleanupDecision',
        'Get-TMPCDiagnosticDirectory',
        'Get-TMPCSetupSummaryPath',
        'Read-TMPCSetupSummary',
        'Write-TMPCSetupSummary',
        'Get-TMPCSetupExecutionId'
    )
    $definitions = foreach ($name in $functionNames) {
        $definition = (Get-Command -Name $name -CommandType Function -ErrorAction Stop).Definition
        "function $name {`n$definition`n}"
    }
    $main = @'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$summaryPath = 'C:\ProgramData\TMPC-Windows-11-Optimization\Logs\SetupSummary.json'
$directoryPath = 'C:\ProgramData\TMPC-Windows-11-Optimization\Logs'
$parentPath = 'C:\ProgramData\TMPC-Windows-11-Optimization'
$setupPath = 'C:\ProgramData\Autounattend'
$markerPath = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Autounattend'
$taskName = 'AutounattendCleanup'
$taskPath = '\Autounattend\'
$state = $null
try { $state = Get-Content -LiteralPath $summaryPath -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $state = $null }
if ($null -eq $state) { Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -TaskPath $taskPath -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0 }
$registryExecutionId = Get-TMPCSetupExecutionId
$directoryAcl = $null
$fileAcl = $null
$parentAcl = $null
$aclOk = $true
try {
    $directoryAcl = Get-TMPCAclSnapshot -Path $directoryPath
    $fileAcl = Get-TMPCAclSnapshot -Path $summaryPath
    $parentAcl = Get-TMPCAclSnapshot -Path $parentPath
} catch { $aclOk = $false }
$trusted = $false
if ($aclOk) {
    $trusted = (Test-TMPCDiagnosticAclSnapshot -DirectorySnapshot $directoryAcl -FileSnapshot $fileAcl) -and
        (Test-TMPCDirectoryAclSnapshot -Snapshot $parentAcl) -and
        (Test-TMPCSetupSummarySchema -Summary $state -ExpectedRevision 'R2-local') -and
        (Test-TMPCSetupExecutionIdentity -Summary $state -RegistryExecutionId $registryExecutionId)
}
if (-not $trusted) { Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -TaskPath $taskPath -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0 }
$taskState = Get-TMPCCleanupTaskState
$decision = 'STOP'
try {
    $decision = Get-TMPCCleanupDecision -Summary $state -RegistryExecutionId $registryExecutionId -DirectoryAcl $directoryAcl -FileAcl $fileAcl -TaskState $taskState -ExpectedRevision 'R2-local'
} catch {
    $decision = 'STOP'
}
$attempt = [int]$state.CleanupAttempts + 1
$cleanup = 'DEFERRED'
$reason = $decision
if ($decision -eq 'ALLOW') {
    $preOk = $true
    try {
        $null = Write-TMPCSetupSummary -Values @{ CleanupStatus='IN_PROGRESS'; CleanupAttempts=$attempt; CleanupReason='ALLOWED'; CleanupTimestampUtc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }
    } catch { $preOk = $false }
    if (-not $preOk) {
        $cleanup = 'FAILED'
        $reason = 'SUMMARY_WRITE_FAILED'
    } else {
        $deleted = $false
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt 3; $i++) {
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $setupPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $markerPath -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if ((-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setupPath)) -and (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $markerPath))) { $deleted = $true; break }
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        }
        if ($deleted) { $cleanup = 'SUCCESS'; $reason = 'DELETED_AND_VERIFIED' }
        else { $cleanup = 'FAILED'; $reason = 'DELETION_NOT_VERIFIED' }
    }
} elseif ($decision -eq 'RETRY') {
    $reason = 'TASK_STATE_' + $taskState
} else {
    $reason = 'INTEGRITY_OR_STATUS_STOP'
}
$writeOk = $true
try {
    $null = Write-TMPCSetupSummary -Values @{ CleanupStatus=$cleanup; CleanupAttempts=$attempt; CleanupReason=$reason; CleanupTimestampUtc=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o') }
} catch { $writeOk = $false }
if (-not $writeOk) { $cleanup = 'FAILED'; $reason = 'SUMMARY_WRITE_FAILED' }
if (($cleanup -eq 'SUCCESS') -or ($decision -eq 'STOP') -or ($attempt -ge 3) -or (-not $writeOk)) {
    Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $taskName -TaskPath $taskPath -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
exit 0
'@
    $command = (($definitions -join "`r`n") + "`r`n" + $main)
    if ($command.Contains('"')) { throw 'Cleanup command contains a double quote.' }
    if ($command.Length -gt 30000) { throw 'Cleanup command is too long.' }
    return $command
}

# User-phase retry and completed-operation tracking. The applied-operation list
# is stored per user in HKCU\Software\Autounattend\AppliedOperations (REG_MULTI_SZ)
# and is consulted before each HKCU mutation. A retry therefore does not rewrite
# values that already completed their initial application, even if the user
# changed them afterwards. Tracking is enabled only in the interactive child;
# SYSTEM/HKLM work and the standalone engine are unaffected.
function Get-TMPCOperationKey {
    param([string]$Operation, [string]$Path, [string]$Name, [string]$Type, [string]$Value)
    $material = @($Operation, $Path, [string]$Name, $Type, $Value) -join '|'
    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    try {
        $bytes = $sha.ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($material))
        return ([System.BitConverter]::ToString($bytes)).Replace('-', '').ToLowerInvariant()
    } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
}

function Test-TMPCAppliedOperation {
    param([string]$Key)
    if (-not $script:TrackAppliedOperations) { return $false }
    return $script:AppliedOperationKeys.Contains($Key)
}

function Add-TMPCAppliedOperation {
    param([string]$Key)
    if (-not $script:TrackAppliedOperations) { return }
    if ($script:AppliedOperationKeys.Contains($Key)) { return }
    $null = $script:AppliedOperationKeys.Add($Key)
    $items = @($script:AppliedOperationKeys | Sort-Object)
    $path = 'HKCU:\Software\Autounattend'
    try {
        $pathState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $path -Name $null
        Write-RegistryValue -Path $path -Name 'AppliedOperations' -Type 'MultiString' -Value ([string[]]$items) -PathExists ([bool]$pathState.PathExists)
    } catch {
        $null = $script:AppliedOperationKeys.Remove($Key)
        throw 'STATE_WRITE_FAILED'
    }
    $state = $null
    try { $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $path -Name 'AppliedOperations' }
    catch { throw 'STATE_VERIFY_FAILED' }
    if (-not ($state.ValueExists -and $state.Kind -eq [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::MultiString -and $null -ne $state.Value)) {
        throw 'STATE_VERIFY_FAILED'
    }
    $persisted = @($state.Value | Sort-Object)
    if ($persisted.Count -ne $items.Count) { throw 'STATE_VERIFY_FAILED' }
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $items.Count; $i++) {
        if (-not [string]::Equals([string]$persisted[$i], [string]$items[$i], [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { throw 'STATE_VERIFY_FAILED' }
    }
}

function Initialize-TMPCAppliedOperations {
    $script:AppliedOperationKeys.Clear()
    $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Autounattend' -Name 'AppliedOperations'
    if (-not $state.ValueExists) { return }
    if ($state.Kind -ne [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::MultiString -or $null -eq $state.Value) {
        throw 'Applied operation state has an unexpected type.'
    }
    foreach ($item in @($state.Value)) {
        if ([string]$item -notmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw 'Applied operation state contains an invalid entry.' }
        $null = $script:AppliedOperationKeys.Add([string]$item)
    }
}

function Get-TMPCUserPhaseOutcome {
    param([int]$ExitCode, [bool]$HadErrors, [bool]$Deferred)
    if ($Deferred) { return 'DEFERRED' }
    if ($ExitCode -eq 0 -and -not $HadErrors) { return 'SUCCESS' }
    if ($ExitCode -eq 0 -and $HadErrors) { return 'TRANSIENT' }
    if ($ExitCode -eq 3) { return 'PERMANENT' }
    if ($ExitCode -eq 4) { return 'NOT_APPLICABLE' }
    if ($ExitCode -eq 2) { return 'DEFERRED' }
    if ($ExitCode -eq 1 -or $ExitCode -lt 0) { return 'TRANSIENT' }
    return 'UNKNOWN'
}

function Get-TMPCUserRetryDecision {
    param([bool]$MarkerApplied, [int]$Attempts, [string]$LastOutcome, [int]$MaxAttempts = 3)
    if ($MarkerApplied) { return 'ALREADY_APPLIED' }
    if ($Attempts -ge $MaxAttempts) { return 'EXHAUSTED' }
    if ($LastOutcome -in @('PERMANENT', 'NOT_APPLICABLE')) { return 'STOP_PERMANENT' }
    return 'RUN'
}

function Get-TMPCUserPhaseState {
    $result = [pscustomobject]@{ Available = $true; Attempts = 0; Outcome = 'PENDING'; ExitCode = 0; Reason = '' }
    try {
        $key = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Autounattend'
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $key)) { return $result }
        $attemptState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $key -Name 'UserPhaseAttempts'
        if (-not $attemptState.ValueExists) { return $result }
        if ($attemptState.Kind -ne [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::DWord) { throw 'UserPhaseAttempts is not REG_DWORD.' }
        $result.Attempts = [int]$attemptState.Value
        if ($result.Attempts -lt 0 -or $result.Attempts -gt 3) { throw 'UserPhaseAttempts is out of range.' }
        $outcomeState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $key -Name 'UserPhaseOutcome'
        if ($outcomeState.ValueExists) {
            if ($outcomeState.Kind -ne [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::String) { throw 'UserPhaseOutcome is not REG_SZ.' }
            $result.Outcome = [string]$outcomeState.Value
            if ($result.Outcome -notin @('PENDING', 'SUCCESS', 'TRANSIENT', 'PERMANENT', 'DEFERRED', 'NOT_APPLICABLE', 'UNKNOWN')) { throw 'UserPhaseOutcome is invalid.' }
        }
        $exitState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $key -Name 'UserPhaseExitCode'
        if ($exitState.ValueExists) {
            if ($exitState.Kind -ne [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::DWord) { throw 'UserPhaseExitCode is not REG_DWORD.' }
            $result.ExitCode = [int]$exitState.Value
        }
    } catch {
        $result.Available = $false
        $result.Reason = 'STATE_READ_FAILED'
    }
    return $result
}

function Set-TMPCUserPhaseState {
    param([int]$Attempts, [string]$Outcome, [int]$ExitCode)
    $key = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Autounattend'
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $key)) { New-Item -Path $key -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null }
    try {
        Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $key -Name 'UserPhaseAttempts' -Type DWord -Value $Attempts -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $key -Name 'UserPhaseOutcome' -Type String -Value $Outcome -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $key -Name 'UserPhaseExitCode' -Type DWord -Value $ExitCode -Force -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch { throw 'STATE_WRITE_FAILED' }
    $attemptState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $key -Name 'UserPhaseAttempts'
    $outcomeState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $key -Name 'UserPhaseOutcome'
    $exitState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $key -Name 'UserPhaseExitCode'
    if (-not ($attemptState.ValueExists -and [int]$attemptState.Value -eq $Attempts -and
        $outcomeState.ValueExists -and [string]$outcomeState.Value -eq $Outcome -and
        $exitState.ValueExists -and [int]$exitState.Value -eq $ExitCode)) {
        throw 'STATE_VERIFY_FAILED'
    }
}

# Registry helpers. Mutations use -ErrorAction Stop so real failures set
# $script:CustomizationHadErrors. Binary helpers preserve the existing blob.
# The engine mirrors the standalone one: read the live state, compare kind and
# value exactly, write only when needed and verify the result. States:
# ALREADY_COMPLIANT (no write), APPLIED (write verified), READ_DENIED,
# WRITE_DENIED, WRITE_FAILED, VERIFY_FAILED and CONFLICTING_STATE. A failed
# read never assumes absence and never leads to a blind write. Logs carry the
# description and the state, not registry blobs or raw error payloads.
#
# The unnamed default value is named by the empty string in
# RegistryKey.GetValueNames(); the readable inventory alias "(Default)" is
# normalized to that empty name so reads and verification address the real
# default value. No other value name is rewritten.
function ConvertTo-RegistryValueName {
    param($Name)
    if ($null -ne $Name -and [string]::Equals([string]$Name, '(Default)', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return ''
    }
    return $Name
}

function Test-RegistryValueName {
    # Models RegistryKey.GetValueNames(): the default value is named "".
    param([string[]]$ValueNames, $Name)
    $normalizedName = ConvertTo-RegistryValueName -Name $Name
    if ($null -eq $normalizedName) { return $false }
    return @($ValueNames) -contains $normalizedName
}

function Get-RegistryEntryState {
    # $Name is deliberately untyped: $null means "probe the key only", while an
    # empty string means the unnamed default value.
    param([string]$Path, $Name)
    $normalizedName = ConvertTo-RegistryValueName -Name $Name
    $pathExists = $false
    $valueExists = $false
    $kind = $null
    $value = $null
    try {
        $key = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch [System.Management.Automation.ItemNotFoundException] {
        $key = $null
    } catch [System.Management.Automation.DriveNotFoundException] {
        $key = $null
    }
    if ($key) {
        $pathExists = $true
        try {
            if ($null -ne $normalizedName) {
                $valueExists = Test-RegistryValueName -ValueNames @($key.GetValueNames()) -Name $normalizedName
                if ($valueExists) {
                    $kind = $key.GetValueKind($normalizedName)
                    $value = $key.GetValue($normalizedName)
                }
            }
        } finally { $key.Close() }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ PathExists = $pathExists; ValueExists = $valueExists; Kind = $kind; Value = $value }
}

function Test-RegistryStateEqual {
    param([string]$Type, $Expected, $Kind, $Value)
    $expectedKind = switch ($Type) {
        'DWord' { [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::DWord }
        'String' { [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::String }
        'ExpandString' { [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::ExpandString }
        'Binary' { [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::Binary }
        'MultiString' { [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::MultiString }
        default { throw 'Unsupported registry type.' }
    }
    if ($Kind -ne $expectedKind) { return $false }
    if ($Type -eq 'Binary') {
        if ($null -eq $Value -or $Value -isnot [byte[]]) { return $false }
        if ($Value.Length -ne $Expected.Length) { return $false }
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $Expected.Length; $i++) { if ($Value[$i] -ne $Expected[$i]) { return $false } }
        return $true
    }
    if ($Type -eq 'MultiString') {
        $actualItems = @($Value)
        $expectedItems = @($Expected)
        if ($actualItems.Count -ne $expectedItems.Count) { return $false }
        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $expectedItems.Count; $i++) {
            if (-not [string]::Equals([string]$actualItems[$i], [string]$expectedItems[$i], [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { return $false }
        }
        return $true
    }
    if ($Type -eq 'DWord') { return ([int]$Value -eq [int]$Expected) }
    return [string]::Equals([string]$Value, [string]$Expected, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
}

function Write-RegistryValue {
    # Sole registry write primitive for Set-RegistryValue. The provider maps
    # "(Default)" to the unnamed value; an empty -Name does not bind in Windows
    # PowerShell 5.1, so the alias is used only at this boundary.
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Name,
        [string]$Type,
        $Value,
        [bool]$PathExists
    )
    $providerName = if ($Name -eq '') { '(Default)' } else { $Name }
    if (-not $PathExists) { New-Item -Path $Path -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null }
    Set-ItemProperty -Path $Path -Name $providerName -Value $Value -Type $Type -Force -ErrorAction Stop
}

function Get-RegistryErrorReason {
    param($ErrorRecord)
    $reason = $ErrorRecord.Exception.Message
    if ($reason -in @('READ_DENIED','WRITE_DENIED','WRITE_FAILED','VERIFY_FAILED','CONFLICTING_STATE','STATE_WRITE_FAILED','STATE_VERIFY_FAILED','Unsupported registry type.')) { return $reason }
    return '{0}, HRESULT 0x{1:X8}' -f $ErrorRecord.Exception.GetType().Name, $ErrorRecord.Exception.HResult
}

function Set-RegistryValue {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Name,
        [string]$Type,
        $Value,
        [string]$Description
    )

    $displayName = $Name
    $Name = ConvertTo-RegistryValueName -Name $Name
    try {
        $expected = $Value
        if ($Type -eq 'Binary') { $expected = [byte[]]$Value }
        if ($Type -eq 'DWord') { $expected = [int]$Value }
        if ($Type -eq 'MultiString') { $expected = [string[]]$Value }
        $operationKey = $null
        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) {
            $operationValue = if ($Type -eq 'Binary') { (@($expected | ForEach-Object { '{0:X2}' -f [byte]$_ }) -join ',') } else { [string]$expected }
            $operationKey = Get-TMPCOperationKey -Operation 'SET' -Path $Path -Name ([string]$Name) -Type $Type -Value $operationValue
            if (Test-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey) {
                Write-Log "$Description | $Path\$displayName | ALREADY_COMPLETED_PREVIOUS_RUN; no write performed" "INFO"
                return
            }
        }
        $state = $null
        try { $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $Name }
        catch { throw 'READ_DENIED' }
        if ($state.ValueExists -and (Test-RegistryStateEqual -Type $Type -Expected $expected -Kind $state.Kind -Value $state.Value)) {
            if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) { Add-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey }
            Write-Log "$Description | $Path\$displayName | ALREADY_COMPLIANT; no write performed" "INFO"
            return
        }
        try {
            # Binary writes must receive the byte[] conversion, never the raw
            # Object[] that the caller may use to express the bytes.
            Write-RegistryValue -Path $Path -Name $Name -Type $Type -Value $expected -PathExists ([bool]$state.PathExists)
        } catch {
            $denied = ($_.Exception -is [System.UnauthorizedAccessException]) -or ($_.Exception -is [System.Security.SecurityException])
            if ($denied) { throw 'WRITE_DENIED' }
            throw 'WRITE_FAILED'
        }
        $after = $null
        try { $after = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $Name }
        catch { throw 'VERIFY_FAILED' }
        if (-not ($after.ValueExists -and (Test-RegistryStateEqual -Type $Type -Expected $expected -Kind $after.Kind -Value $after.Value))) {
            throw 'VERIFY_FAILED'
        }
        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) { Add-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey }
        Write-Log "$Description | $Path\$displayName | APPLIED and verified" "SUCCESS"
    }
    catch {
        $reason = Get-RegistryErrorReason $_
        if ($reason -in @('READ_DENIED','WRITE_DENIED','CONFLICTING_STATE','STATE_WRITE_FAILED','STATE_VERIFY_FAILED')) { $script:PermanentErrorCount++ }
        $script:CustomizationHadErrors = $true
        Write-Log "Failed to set $Path\$displayName | $reason" "ERROR"
    }
}

function Remove-RegistryValue {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Name,
        [string]$Description
    )

    try {
        $operationKey = $null
        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) {
            $operationKey = Get-TMPCOperationKey -Operation 'REMOVEVALUE' -Path $Path -Name $Name -Type '' -Value ''
            if (Test-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey) {
                Write-Log "$Description | $Path\$Name | ALREADY_COMPLETED_PREVIOUS_RUN; value absent" "INFO"
                return
            }
        }
        $state = $null
        try { $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $Name }
        catch { throw 'READ_DENIED' }
        if (-not $state.ValueExists) {
            if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) { Add-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey }
            Write-Log "$Description | $Path\$Name | ALREADY_COMPLIANT; value absent" "INFO"
            return
        }
        try { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $Path -Name $Name -ErrorAction Stop }
        catch { throw 'WRITE_DENIED' }
        $after = $null
        try { $after = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $Name }
        catch { throw 'VERIFY_FAILED' }
        if ($after.ValueExists) { throw 'VERIFY_FAILED' }
        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) { Add-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey }
        Write-Log "$Description | Removed $Path\$Name | APPLIED and verified" "SUCCESS"
    }
    catch {
        $reason = Get-RegistryErrorReason $_
        if ($reason -in @('READ_DENIED','WRITE_DENIED','CONFLICTING_STATE','STATE_WRITE_FAILED','STATE_VERIFY_FAILED')) { $script:PermanentErrorCount++ }
        $script:CustomizationHadErrors = $true
        Write-Log "Failed to remove $Path\$Name | $reason" "ERROR"
    }
}

function Remove-RegistryKey {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Description
    )

    try {
        $operationKey = $null
        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) {
            $operationKey = Get-TMPCOperationKey -Operation 'REMOVEKEY' -Path $Path -Name '' -Type '' -Value ''
            if (Test-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey) {
                Write-Log "$Description | $Path | ALREADY_COMPLETED_PREVIOUS_RUN; key absent" "INFO"
                return
            }
        }
        $state = $null
        try { $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $null }
        catch { throw 'READ_DENIED' }
        if (-not $state.PathExists) {
            if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) { Add-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey }
            Write-Log "$Description | $Path | ALREADY_COMPLIANT; key absent" "INFO"
            return
        }
        try { Remove-Item -Path $Path -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
        catch { throw 'WRITE_DENIED' }
        $after = $null
        try { $after = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $null }
        catch { throw 'VERIFY_FAILED' }
        if ($after.PathExists) { throw 'VERIFY_FAILED' }
        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) { Add-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey }
        Write-Log "$Description | Removed key $Path | APPLIED and verified" "SUCCESS"
    }
    catch {
        $reason = Get-RegistryErrorReason $_
        if ($reason -in @('READ_DENIED','WRITE_DENIED','CONFLICTING_STATE','STATE_WRITE_FAILED','STATE_VERIFY_FAILED')) { $script:PermanentErrorCount++ }
        $script:CustomizationHadErrors = $true
        Write-Log "Failed to remove key $Path | $reason" "ERROR"
    }
}

function New-RegistryKey {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Description
    )

    try {
        $operationKey = $null
        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) {
            $operationKey = Get-TMPCOperationKey -Operation 'NEWKEY' -Path $Path -Name '' -Type '' -Value ''
            if (Test-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey) {

function Set-BinaryBit {
    param(

    try {
        $operationKey = $null
        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) {
            $operationKey = Get-TMPCOperationKey -Operation 'BINARYBIT' -Path $Path -Name $Name -Type 'BinaryBit' -Value ("{0}|{1}|{2}" -f $ByteIndex, $BitMask, $SetBit)
            if (Test-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey) {
                Write-Log "$Description | $Path\$Name bit mask 0x$($BitMask.ToString('X2')) at byte $ByteIndex | ALREADY_COMPLETED_PREVIOUS_RUN; no write performed" "INFO"
                return
            }

        $state = $null
        try { $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $Name }
        catch { throw 'READ_DENIED' }
        $bytes = $null
        if (-not $state.ValueExists -or $null -eq $state.Value) {

        }

        $target = if ($SetBit) { $bytes[$ByteIndex] -bor $BitMask } else { $bytes[$ByteIndex] -band (-bnot $BitMask) }
        if ($state.ValueExists -and $target -eq $bytes[$ByteIndex]) {
            if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) { Add-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey }
            Write-Log "$Description | $Path\$Name bit mask 0x$($BitMask.ToString('X2')) at byte $ByteIndex | ALREADY_COMPLIANT; no write performed" "INFO"

        }

        $updated = New-Object byte[] $bytes.Length
        [Array]::Copy($bytes, $updated, $bytes.Length)
        $updated[$ByteIndex] = $target
        try {
            if (-not $state.PathExists) { New-Item -Path $Path -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null }
            Set-ItemProperty -Path $Path -Name $Name -Value $updated -Type Binary -Force -ErrorAction Stop

        if ($script:TrackAppliedOperations) { Add-TMPCAppliedOperation -Key $operationKey }
        Write-Log "$Description | $Path\$Name bit mask 0x$($BitMask.ToString('X2')) at byte $ByteIndex = $SetBit | APPLIED and verified" "SUCCESS"
    }
    catch {
        $reason = Get-RegistryErrorReason $_
        if ($reason -in @('READ_DENIED','WRITE_DENIED','CONFLICTING_STATE','STATE_WRITE_FAILED','STATE_VERIFY_FAILED')) { $script:PermanentErrorCount++ }
        $script:CustomizationHadErrors = $true

# One-shot bridge from SYSTEM to the interactive user. Registration is verified; the task is
# removed after success or kept so the next logon retries.
function Register-AutounattendUserCustomizationsTask {
    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "powershell.exe" -Argument "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -File C:\ProgramData\Autounattend\Unattend\Scripts\SystemCustomizations.ps1 -UserCustomizations"
    $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -ExecutionTimeLimit 0
    $principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId "SYSTEM" -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName "AutounattendUserCustomizations" -TaskPath "\Autounattend" -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Settings $settings -Principal $principal -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    $registeredTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName "AutounattendUserCustomizations" -TaskPath "\Autounattend\" -ErrorAction Stop

    }

function Remove-TMPCAutounattendUserCustomizationsTask {
    # Bounded retries and permanent outcomes must not leave a resident task.
    # Removal is verified; a failure is reported and never converted to success.
    try {
        Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName "AutounattendUserCustomizations" -TaskPath "\Autounattend\" -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction Stop
        $remaining = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName "AutounattendUserCustomizations" -TaskPath "\Autounattend\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($remaining) { throw "AutounattendUserCustomizations is still registered after the unregister attempt." }

    } catch {

    }

# Runs a child process in the interactive user's session from SYSTEM: duplicates the explorer
# token (elevated linked token under UAC) and waits up to 10 minutes; success is exit code 0.
# Required because HKCU must be written in the user's own context.
function Start-ProcessAsUser {
    param(
        [string]$CommandLine,
        [int]$TargetSessionId,
        [string]$ExpectedSid
    )

    $script:LastChildExitCode = -1
    if (-not ([System.Management.Automation.PSTypeName]'Autounattend.TL'.Type)) {
        Add-Type -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("advapi32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool OpenProcessToken(IntPtr h,uint a,out IntPtr t);
[DllImport("advapi32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool GetTokenInformation(IntPtr t,int c,IntPtr i,int l,out int r);
[DllImport("advapi32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool DuplicateTokenEx(IntPtr t,uint a,IntPtr s,int il,int tt,out IntPtr n);
[DllImport("advapi32.dll",SetLastError=true,CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)]public static extern bool CreateProcessAsUserW(IntPtr t,string app,string cmd,IntPtr pa,IntPtr ta,bool ih,int cf,IntPtr env,string dir,ref SI si,out PI pi);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool CloseHandle(IntPtr h);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern uint WaitForSingleObject(IntPtr h,uint ms);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool GetExitCodeProcess(IntPtr h,out uint c);
[DllImport("userenv.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool CreateEnvironmentBlock(out IntPtr env,IntPtr token,bool inherit);
[DllImport("userenv.dll",SetLastError=true)]public static extern bool DestroyEnvironmentBlock(IntPtr env);
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential,CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)]public struct SI{public int cb;public string r1,d,t;public int x,y,w,h,cc,cr,fa,fl;public short sw,r2;public IntPtr r3,i,o,e;}
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]public struct PI{public IntPtr hp,ht;public int pid,tid;}
'@ -Name TL -Namespace Autounattend -ErrorAction Stop
    }

    $T = [Autounattend.TL]
    $tok = $dup = $envBlock = $linked = [IntPtr]::Zero
    $pi = New-Object Autounattend.TL+PI
    $launched = $false

    try {
        if ($TargetSessionId -le 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ExpectedSid)) {
            Write-Log "Child launch rejected: missing target session or expected identity" "ERROR"
            return $false
        }

        $processes = @()
        foreach ($p in @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'explorer.exe'" -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            if ([int]$p.SessionId -ne $TargetSessionId) { continue }
            $owner = $null
            try { $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $p -MethodName GetOwnerSid -ErrorAction Stop } catch { }
            if ($null -eq $owner -or $owner.ReturnValue -ne 0 -or -not (Test-TMPCIdentityMatch -ExpectedSid $ExpectedSid -ActualSid ([string]$owner.Sid))) {
                Write-Log "Explorer identity does not match the expected interactive identity" "ERROR"
                return $false
            }
            $processes += $p
        }
        if ($processes.Count -eq 0) {
            Write-Log "No explorer.exe in target session $TargetSessionId" "ERROR"
            return $false
        }

        $ep = Get-Process -Id ([int]$processes[0].ProcessId) -ErrorAction Stop
        if (-not $T::OpenProcessToken($ep.Handle, 0x000A, [ref]$tok)) {
            Write-Log "OpenProcessToken failed (err $([Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::GetLastWin32Error()))" "ERROR"; return $false
        }

        $tokenSid = $null
        try {
            $tokenIdentity = New-Object System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity -ArgumentList $tok
            $tokenSid = [string]$tokenIdentity.User.Value
            $tokenIdentity.Dispose()
        } catch { }
        if (-not (Test-TMPCIdentityMatch -ExpectedSid $ExpectedSid -ActualSid $tokenSid)) {
            Write-Log "Explorer token identity does not match the expected identity" "ERROR"
            return $false
        }

        # If user is admin with UAC, use the linked elevated token only after
        # verifying that the linked token belongs to the same SID.
        $dupSrc = $tok
        $eb = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::AllocHGlobal(4); $rl = 0
        if ($T::GetTokenInformation($tok, 18, $eb, 4, [ref]$rl) -and [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReadInt32($eb) -eq 3) {
            $lb = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::AllocHGlobal([IntPtr]::Size)
            if ($T::GetTokenInformation($tok, 19, $lb, [IntPtr]::Size, [ref]$rl)) {
                $linked = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReadIntPtr($lb)
                $linkedSid = $null
                try {
                    $linkedIdentity = New-Object System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity -ArgumentList $linked
                    $linkedSid = [string]$linkedIdentity.User.Value
                    $linkedIdentity.Dispose()
                } catch { }
                if (-not (Test-TMPCIdentityMatch -ExpectedSid $ExpectedSid -ActualSid $linkedSid)) {
                    Write-Log "Linked elevated token identity does not match the expected identity" "ERROR"
                    return $false
                }
                $dupSrc = $linked
                Write-Log "Using elevated linked token for the verified identity" "INFO"
            }
            [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::FreeHGlobal($lb)
        }
        [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::FreeHGlobal($eb)

        if (-not $T::DuplicateTokenEx($dupSrc, 0xF01FF, [IntPtr]::Zero, 2, 1, [ref]$dup)) {
            Write-Log "DuplicateTokenEx failed (err $([Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::GetLastWin32Error()))" "ERROR"; return $false
        }

        $dupSid = $null
        try {
            $dupIdentity = New-Object System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity -ArgumentList $dup
            $dupSid = [string]$dupIdentity.User.Value
            $dupIdentity.Dispose()
        } catch { }
        if (-not (Test-TMPCIdentityMatch -ExpectedSid $ExpectedSid -ActualSid $dupSid)) {
            Write-Log "Duplicated token identity does not match the expected identity" "ERROR"
            return $false
        }

        if ($linked -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) {
            $null = $T::CloseHandle($linked)
            $linked = [IntPtr]::Zero
        }

        $null = $T::CreateEnvironmentBlock([ref]$envBlock, $dup, $false)

        $si = New-Object Autounattend.TL+SI
        $si.cb = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SizeOf($si)
        $si.d = "winsta0\default"
        $psExe = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe"

        if (-not $T::CreateProcessAsUserW($dup, $psExe, $CommandLine, [IntPtr]::Zero, [IntPtr]::Zero, $false, 0x08000400, $envBlock, $env:SystemRoot, [ref]$si, [ref]$pi)) {
            Write-Log "CreateProcessAsUserW failed (err $([Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::GetLastWin32Error()))" "ERROR"; return $false
        }

        $launched = $true
        Write-Log "Launched child process for the verified identity (PID $($pi.pid))" "INFO"

        $wait = $T::WaitForSingleObject($pi.hp, 600000)
        if ($wait -ne 0) { Write-Log "Child process timed out" "ERROR"; $script:LastChildExitCode = -2; return $false }

        $ec = [uint32]0
        $null = $T::GetExitCodeProcess($pi.hp, [ref]$ec)
        $script:LastChildExitCode = [int]$ec
        Write-Log "Child process exited with code $ec" "INFO"
        return ($ec -eq 0)
    }
    catch { Write-Log "Start-ProcessAsUser: $($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR"; return $false }
    finally {
        if ($launched) {
            if ($pi.ht -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { $null = $T::CloseHandle($pi.ht) }
            if ($pi.hp -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { $null = $T::CloseHandle($pi.hp) }
        }
        if ($envBlock -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { $null = $T::DestroyEnvironmentBlock($envBlock) }
        if ($dup -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { $null = $T::CloseHandle($dup) }
        if ($linked -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { $null = $T::CloseHandle($linked) }
        if ($tok -ne [IntPtr]::Zero) { $null = $T::CloseHandle($tok) }
    }
}

# Parallel removal with sequential fallback; real failures set $script:HadErrors, which drives
# the exit code consumed by SystemCustomizations.ps1.
function Invoke-RunspacePool {
    param (
        [array]$Items,
        [scriptblock]$ScriptBlock,
        [int]$MaxThreads = 10,
        [string]$Label,
        [string]$SuccessFormat,
        [string]$FailFormat
    )
    if ($Items.Count -eq 0) { return }

    try {
        $threadCount = [Math]::Min($Items.Count, $MaxThreads)
        Write-Log "Removing $($Items.Count) $Label via runspace pool (threads=$threadCount)..."
        $pool = [RunspaceFactory]::CreateRunspacePool(1, $threadCount)
        $pool.Open()
        $jobs = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()

        foreach ($item in $Items) {
            $ps = [PowerShell]::Create().AddScript($ScriptBlock).AddArgument($item)
            $ps.RunspacePool = $pool
            $jobs.Add(@{ Pipe = $ps; Handle = $ps.BeginInvoke() })
        }

        foreach ($job in $jobs) {
            $result = $job.Pipe.EndInvoke($job.Handle)
            foreach ($r in $result) {
                if ($r.Success) { Write-Log ($SuccessFormat -f $r.Name) }
                else {
                    Write-Log ($FailFormat -f $r.Name, $r.Error)
                    $script:HadErrors = $true
                }
            }
            $job.Pipe.Dispose()
        }
        $pool.Close()
        $pool.Dispose()
        Write-Log "Parallel $Label removal completed"
    } catch {
        Write-Log "Parallel execution unavailable, falling back to sequential removal for $Label..."
        foreach ($item in $Items) {
            $r = & $ScriptBlock $item
            if ($r.Success) { Write-Log ($SuccessFormat -f $r.Name) }
            else {
                Write-Log ($FailFormat -f $r.Name, $r.Error)
                $script:HadErrors = $true
            }
        }
        Write-Log "Sequential $Label removal completed"
    }
}

# final-execution primitives below are the only system I/O entry points for the
# hardened OneDrive flow. The isolated test suite extracts these functions and

function Get-RegistryEntryState {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Name)
    $pathExists = $false
    $valueExists = $false
    $kind = $null
    $value = $null
    try {
        $key = Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch [System.Management.Automation.ItemNotFoundException] {
        $key = $null
    } catch [System.Management.Automation.DriveNotFoundException] {
        $key = $null
    }
    if ($key) {
        $pathExists = $true
        try {
            if ($Name) {
                $valueExists = @($key.GetValueNames()) -contains $Name
                if ($valueExists) {
                    $kind = $key.GetValueKind($Name)
                    $value = $key.GetValue($Name)
                }
            }
        } finally { $key.Close() }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{ PathExists = $pathExists; ValueExists = $valueExists; Kind = $kind; Value = $value }
}

function Get-RegistryErrorReason {
    param($ErrorRecord)
    $reason = $ErrorRecord.Exception.Message
    if ($reason -in @('READ_DENIED','WRITE_DENIED','WRITE_FAILED','VERIFY_FAILED','CONFLICTING_STATE','STATE_WRITE_FAILED','STATE_VERIFY_FAILED','Unsupported registry type.')) { return $reason }
    return '{0}, HRESULT 0x{1:X8}' -f $ErrorRecord.Exception.GetType().Name, $ErrorRecord.Exception.HResult
}

function Remove-RegistryEntryIfPresent {
    # Idempotent removal: an absent key or value is already compliant; any
    # deletion is verified. Returns the state string; throws the state on error.
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Name)
    $state = $null
    try { $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $Name }
    catch { throw 'READ_DENIED' }
    if (-not $state.PathExists) { return 'ALREADY_COMPLIANT' }
    if ($Name -and -not $state.ValueExists) { return 'ALREADY_COMPLIANT' }
    try {
        if ($Name) { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $Path -Name $Name -ErrorAction Stop }
        else { Remove-Item -Path $Path -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop }
    } catch { throw 'WRITE_DENIED' }
    $after = $null
    try { $after = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $Name }
    catch { throw 'VERIFY_FAILED' }
    if ($Name) { if ($after.ValueExists) { throw 'VERIFY_FAILED' } }
    else { if ($after.PathExists) { throw 'VERIFY_FAILED' } }
    return 'APPLIED'
}

function Get-TMPCPathItem {
    param([string]$Path)
    Get-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Force -ErrorAction Stop
}

function Assert-NoReparsePath {
    param([string]$Path)
    $item = Get-TMPCPathItem -Path $Path
    while ($item) {
        if (($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { throw 'Linked path preserved.' }
        $parent = Split-Path -Parent $item.FullName
        if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $item.FullName) { break }
        $item = Get-TMPCPathItem -Path $parent
    }
}

function Remove-OneDriveRemnant {
    param([string]$Path, [string[]]$AllowedRoots, [string[]]$ProtectedRoots)
    # Sole filesystem deletion entry point for OneDrive remnants: exact
    # allowlist, protected sync roots and link rejection, one level at a time.
    if (-not $script:OneDriveProtectionReady) { throw 'Sync-root protection inventory unavailable; remnants preserved.' }
    $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path).TrimEnd('\')
    foreach ($root in @($ProtectedRoots)) {
        if (-not $root) { continue }
        $sync = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($root).TrimEnd('\')
        if ($full -eq $sync -or $full.StartsWith($sync+'\',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or
            $sync.StartsWith($full+'\',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'Sync-root overlap; personal files preserved.' }
    }
    if ($AllowedRoots -notcontains $full) { throw 'Deletion target rejected; OneDrive user data is protected.' }
    $leaf = $null
    try { $leaf = Get-TMPCPathItem -Path $full }
    catch [System.Management.Automation.ItemNotFoundException] { $leaf = $null }
    if ($null -eq $leaf) { return 'ALREADY_COMPLIANT' }
    if (($leaf.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { throw 'Linked remnant preserved.' }
    Assert-NoReparsePath $full
    # Inspect one level at a time, BEFORE descending: never traverse a junction.
    $pending = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.Stack[string]'
    $pending.Push($full)
    while ($pending.Count -gt 0) {
        $current = $pending.Pop()
        $item = Get-TMPCPathItem -Path $current
        if (($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { throw 'Linked remnant preserved.' }
        if ($item.PSIsContainer) {
            foreach ($child in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $current -Force)) { $pending.Push($child.FullName) }
        }
    }
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $full -Recurse -Force
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full) { throw 'Software remnant still present.' }
    return 'APPLIED'
}

function Invoke-OneDriveUninstaller {
    param([string]$RegistryPath, [switch]$Machine)
    # No cmd.exe, arbitrary registry command or shell expansion: only the
    # installed OneDriveSetup.exe with baseline uninstall switches, inside known
    # software locations and with a valid Microsoft signature, is executed.
    # This variant runs as SYSTEM during Setup, where the machine entry is the
    # inbox stub (System32\OneDriveSetup.exe); user-scope entries are deferred
    # by the caller instead of being executed as SYSTEM. A machine-scope entry
    # must use the explicit /allusers uninstall scope.
    $state = $null
    try { $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $RegistryPath -Name 'UninstallString' }
    catch { throw 'READ_DENIED' }
    if (-not $state.PathExists -or -not $state.ValueExists) { return $false }
    if ($state.Kind -ne [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::String) {
        Write-Log "OneDrive uninstall entry is not a string value; preserved for manual review."
        return $false
    }
    $command = [string]$state.Value
    if ($command -notmatch '^"?(.+?OneDriveSetup\.exe)"?\s+(/uninstall(?:\s+/allusers)?)\s*$') {
        Write-Log "OneDrive uninstall command is not a recognized safe form; preserved for manual review."
        return $false
    }
    $exe = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($matches[1])
    $arguments = $matches[2]
    if ($Machine -and $arguments -ne '/uninstall /allusers') {
        Write-Log "Machine OneDrive uninstall lacks allusers scope; deferred to avoid wrong-account removal."
        return $false
    }
    $roots = @((Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Microsoft OneDrive'), (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32'), (Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'SysWOW64'))
    $trusted = $false
    foreach ($root in $roots) {
        if ($exe.StartsWith($root+'\',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { $trusted = $true }
    }
    if (-not $trusted) { throw 'Uninstaller outside known software locations.' }
    Assert-NoReparsePath $exe
    $signature = Get-TMPCSignature -Path $exe
    if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid' -or $signature.SignerCertificate.Subject -notmatch 'O=Microsoft Corporation') {
        throw 'OneDrive uninstaller signature not verified.'
    }
    $process = Start-TMPCVerifiedUninstaller -FilePath $exe -Arguments $arguments
    if ($null -eq $process -or $process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'OneDrive uninstaller failed.' }
    return $true
}

function Get-TMPCOneDriveRegistrationState {

    # absence. A denied or failed read is UNKNOWN and never authorizes cleanup.

    $state = $null
    try { $state = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $Path -Name $null }
    catch { return 'UNKNOWN' }
    if ($state.PathExists) { return 'PRESENT' }
    return 'ABSENT_VERIFIED'
}

function Invoke-DefaultOneDrivePolicy {
    # Unique temporary mount, no foreign hive unload, bounded unload retries and
    # a marker written only after the temporary key is verified absent.
    $markerKey = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Autounattend\OneDriveRemoval'
    $markerState = $null
    try { $markerState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $markerKey -Name 'DefaultUserConfigured' }
    catch { return 'DEFERRED' }
    if ($markerState.ValueExists) {
        if ($markerState.Kind -eq [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::String -and
            ([string]$markerState.Value).StartsWith('R1|', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) {
            return 'ALREADY_COMPLIANT'
        }
        # A legacy or malformed marker cannot prove that unload was verified.
        # Re-run the operation and keep the old marker until a verified unload.
    }

    try { $defaultHivePath = Get-TMPCDefaultHivePath } catch { return 'DEFERRED' }
    if (-not $defaultHivePath) { return 'DEFERRED' }
    try {
        $hiveItem = Get-TMPCPathItem -Path $defaultHivePath
        if ($hiveItem.PSIsContainer) { return 'DEFERRED' }
        Assert-NoReparsePath $defaultHivePath
    } catch { return 'DEFERRED' }

    $mountName = 'TMPC_Default_' + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
    if (Test-TMPCDefaultHiveMounted -MountName $mountName) { return 'DEFERRED' }
    $loadExit = Invoke-TMPCDefaultHiveLoad -MountName $mountName -HivePath $defaultHivePath
    if ($loadExit -ne 0 -or -not (Test-TMPCDefaultHiveMounted -MountName $mountName)) {
        Write-Log "Default user hive load failed or its temporary mount was not verified."
        return 'FAILED'
    }

    $mounted = $true
    $configured = $false
    try {
        $runKey = "Registry::HKEY_USERS\$mountName\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"
        $runState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $runKey -Name 'OneDriveSetup'
        if ($runState.ValueExists) {
            $null = Remove-RegistryEntryIfPresent -Path $runKey -Name 'OneDriveSetup'
            Write-Log "Removed the default user OneDriveSetup Run entry"
        }

        $thdfKey = "Registry::HKEY_USERS\$mountName\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\OneDrive"
        $thdfState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $thdfKey -Name 'EnableTHDFFeatures'
        if ($thdfState.ValueExists -and $thdfState.Kind -eq [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::DWord -and $thdfState.Value -eq 0) {
            $configured = $true
            Write-Log "Default user OneDrive policy already compliant"
        } else {
            if (-not $thdfState.PathExists) { New-TMPCRegistryKey -Path $thdfKey }
            Set-TMPCRegistryEntryValue -Path $thdfKey -Name 'EnableTHDFFeatures' -Type DWord -Value 0
            $thdfAfter = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $thdfKey -Name 'EnableTHDFFeatures'
            if ($thdfAfter.ValueExists -and $thdfAfter.Kind -eq [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::DWord -and $thdfAfter.Value -eq 0) {
                $configured = $true
                Write-Log "Default user OneDrive policy staged and verified"
            } else {
                throw 'VERIFY_FAILED'
            }
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Log "Default user configuration failed: $(Get-RegistryErrorReason $_)"
        $configured = $false
    } finally {
        if ($mounted) {
            [GC]::Collect()
            [GC]::WaitForPendingFinalizers()
            $unloaded = $false
            for ($attempt = 1; $attempt -le 3; $attempt++) {
                $unloadExit = Invoke-TMPCDefaultHiveUnload -MountName $mountName
                if ($unloadExit -eq 0 -and -not (Test-TMPCDefaultHiveMounted -MountName $mountName)) {
                    $unloaded = $true
                    break
                }
                Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
            }
            if (-not $unloaded) {
                Write-Log "Default user hive unload was not verified; the completion marker will not be written."
                $configured = $false
            }
        }
    }

    if (-not $configured) { return 'FAILED' }

    try {
        $markerParent = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Autounattend' -Name $null
        if (-not $markerParent.PathExists) { New-TMPCRegistryKey -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Autounattend' }
        $markerKeyState = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $markerKey -Name $null
        if (-not $markerKeyState.PathExists) { New-TMPCRegistryKey -Path $markerKey }
        $markerValue = 'R1|' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
        Set-TMPCRegistryEntryValue -Path $markerKey -Name 'DefaultUserConfigured' -Type String -Value $markerValue
        $markerAfter = Get-RegistryEntryState -Path $markerKey -Name 'DefaultUserConfigured'
        if (-not ($markerAfter.ValueExists -and $markerAfter.Kind -eq [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::String -and [string]$markerAfter.Value -eq $markerValue)) {
            throw 'VERIFY_FAILED'
        }
        Write-Log "Default user configuration completed and marked after verified unload"
        return 'APPLIED'
    } catch {
        Write-Log "Default user configuration completed but the verified marker could not be written: $(Get-RegistryErrorReason $_)"
        return 'FAILED'
    }
}

# Interactive identity resolution by Explorer owner SID and ProfileList BY SID.
# The profile folder name never identifies the account. Ambiguous or unresolved
# identities defer only the user scope; there is no first-account fallback.
function Resolve-TMPCInteractiveIdentity {
    param(
        [object[]]$ExplorerProcesses,
        [object[]]$Profiles,
        [string]$CurrentSid
    )

    $explorers = @($ExplorerProcesses | Where-Object { $_ -and ([int]$_.SessionId -gt 0) })
    if ($explorers.Count -eq 0) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='NO_EXPLORER'; Sid=$null; UserName=$null; SessionId=0; ProfilePath=$null }
    }

    $sessionIds = @($explorers | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.SessionId } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if ($sessionIds.Count -ne 1) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='AMBIGUOUS_SESSION'; Sid=$null; UserName=$null; SessionId=0; ProfilePath=$null }
    }

    $ownerSids = @($explorers | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.OwnerSid } | Where-Object { $_ })
    if ($ownerSids.Count -ne $explorers.Count) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='OWNER_UNKNOWN'; Sid=$null; UserName=$null; SessionId=$sessionIds[0]; ProfilePath=$null }
    }

    $uniqueSids = @($ownerSids | Sort-Object -Unique)
    if ($uniqueSids.Count -ne 1) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='AMBIGUOUS_IDENTITY'; Sid=$null; UserName=$null; SessionId=$sessionIds[0]; ProfilePath=$null }
    }

    $sid = [string]$uniqueSids[0]
    if ($CurrentSid -and -not [string]::Equals($CurrentSid, $sid, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Status='IDENTITY_MISMATCH'; Sid=$sid; UserName=$null; SessionId=$sessionIds[0]; ProfilePath=$null }
    }

    $profile = @($Profiles | Where-Object { $_ -and [string]::Equals([string]$_.Sid, $sid, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Select-Object -First 1)
    if ($profile.Count -eq 0) {

function Get-TMPCInteractiveIdentity {
    $explorers = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    try {
        foreach ($process in @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'explorer.exe'" -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $ownerSid = $null
            $ownerUser = $null
            try {
                $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $process -MethodName GetOwnerSid -ErrorAction Stop
                if ($owner.ReturnValue -eq 0 -and $owner.Sid) { $ownerSid = [string]$owner.Sid }
            } catch { }
            try {
                $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $process -MethodName GetOwner -ErrorAction Stop
                if ($owner.ReturnValue -eq 0 -and $owner.User) { $ownerUser = [string]$owner.User }
            } catch { }
            $null = $explorers.Add([pscustomobject]@{
                SessionId = [int]$process.SessionId
                OwnerSid  = $ownerSid
                OwnerUser = $ownerUser
            })
        }
    } catch { }

    $profiles = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    try {
        foreach ($key in @(Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList' -ErrorAction Stop)) {
            $profilePath = $null
            try { $profilePath = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $key.PSPath -Name 'ProfileImagePath' -ErrorAction Stop).ProfileImagePath } catch { }
            if ($profilePath) {
                $null = $profiles.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Sid = [string]$key.PSChildName; ProfileImagePath = [string]$profilePath })
            }
        }
    } catch { }

    return (Resolve-TMPCInteractiveIdentity -ExplorerProcesses @($explorers) -Profiles @($profiles))
}

            $downloadsFolderTypeId = '{885a186e-a440-4ada-812b-db871b942259}'

            $downloadsHkcuRegPath = "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\FolderTypes\$downloadsFolderTypeId"

                }

                $downloadsSkip = $true
                Write-Log "Downloads view completion state could not be read safely; existing views were preserved" "ERROR"
            }

            } else {
            try {
